provenance.layoutNote: Building envelope uses OpenStreetMap geometry. Interior circulation and shop divisions are manually interpreted from the supplied map; its floor is not confirmed. Upper levels, doorway positions, heights, vertical connections, and tenant coordinates are estimates. Selected tenant levels follow the official directory. Exterior details reference May 2025 photographs. Surrounding residential towers are omitted to keep the model focused and lightweight. No surveyed accuracy percentage or approved evacuation route is claimed. Kenney CC0 furnishings are illustrative.

instructions.assistance: Vertical connections are demonstration estimates; accessible paths require an on-site survey.
instructions.emergency: DEMONSTRATION ONLY. Reference reconstruction, not an approved evacuation map. No evacuation routes or assembly points are supplied. Follow posted signs and facility staff.
